nodes.description: Public state variable holding the Uniswap V2 factory interface at 0xC0AEe478e3658e2610c5F7A4A2E1777cE9e4f2Ac.
Public view function that returns an array of pair addresses for indices [start, start+cnt) from the Uniswap V2 factory.
uint256 start index parameter of getPairs.
uint256 count parameter of getPairs, also used as the length of the returned array.
Local address[] memory array of length cnt filled with factory pair addresses.
uint256 loop counter of the for loop inside getPairs.
Unchecked Solidity 0.6 addition i + start used as the allPairs index; can silently overflow.

edges.reason: Parameter start is added to the loop counter in an unchecked addition.
Loop counter i is added to start in an unchecked addition.
The result of i+start is consumed by getPairs when calling univ2Factory.allPairs.
State variable univ2Factory is read inside getPairs.
cnt determines the length of the local array out.
cnt bounds the for loop executed by getPairs.
Loop counter i is compared against cnt to control iteration.
The value fetched through allPairs(i+start) is stored into out[i].

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter start is used only inside getPairs and is folded into that function node.
Parameter cnt is used only inside getPairs and is folded into that function node.
Local array out is a temporary return buffer of getPairs and is folded into that function node.
Loop counter i directly feeds the unchecked i+start computation and is folded into that unsafe_operation node.
